rationale: Darren is building KinkBNB, a web3 marketplace that relies heavily on blockchain infrastructure (Ethereum, Solidity, IPFS) and full-stack web technologies, while Sen is a full-stack engineer with Python, TypeScript, React, and Next.js expertise—a solid technical fit for the infrastructure and frontend work Darren's platform needs. With Darren actively fundraising and seeking to acquire physical space in San Francisco, Sen's development skills could be valuable as KinkBNB scales its dApp and backend systems.
intro_message: Darren Mckeeman, meet Sen Thotawatte — Sen's full-stack web experience (React, Next.js, TypeScript) could complement the technical build-out Darren needs as KinkBNB scales its blockchain infrastructure and web3 marketplace platform.
